import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_life_expectancy_mortality.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
# Row 183 has '2019\6 (single race)' at 65 years for Asian, not Hispanic
# Column E=Both sexes, F=Male, G=Female
row_idx = df[(df[0].astype(str).str.contains('2019')) & (df.index > 175) & (df.index < 185)].index[0]
male_le = float(df.iloc[row_idx, 5])
female_le = float(df.iloc[row_idx, 6])
result = 'yes' if female_le > male_le else 'no'

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_life_expectancy_mortality.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
# At 75 years for Hispanic females (rows 187 to 191, column J/9)
years = ['2006', '2007', '2008', '2009', '2010']
subset = df[(df.index >= 186) & (df.index <= 202) & (df[0].astype(str).str.strip().isin(years))]
result = round(float(subset[9].astype(float).mean()), 2)

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_life_expectancy_mortality.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
# At birth, Black not Hispanic both sexes is column E (index 4)
# Rows 140 to 153 covers 2006 to 2017
years = [str(y) for y in range(2006, 2018)]
subset = df[(df.index >= 140) & (df.index <= 153) & (df[0].astype(str).str.strip().isin(years))].copy()
subset['val'] = subset[4].astype(float)
best_row = subset.loc[subset['val'].idxmax()]
result = str(best_row[0]).strip()
